newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total Fitness in rehab venture. [CORRECTED 23:41 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bally Total Fitness in rehab venture. [CORRECTED 23:41 GMT]

text.p: Bally Total Fitness Corp said Tuesday it signed an agreement with Continucare Corp to offer outpatient rehabilitation services at its fitness centers.
The program will initially be available in Florida, Texas, Illinois and Ohio, Bally Total Fitness said. The companies plan to offer the service at as many as 100 locations over the next three years.
Continucare manages 32 (corrects from five) outpatient behavioral and physical rehabilitative centers in five states.
Bally Total Fitness operates 320 facilities in 27 states and Canada. Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at eight.
